title_en: The future seen from the past
title_vi: Tương lai nhìn từ quá khứ
theory_html:
A. The future from now and the future from the past

A. Tương lai tính từ bây giờ và tương lai nhìn từ quá khứ

There are a number of ways of talking about an activity or event that was in the future at a particular point in the past. In order to express this idea, we can use the past tenses of the verb forms we would normally use to talk about the future. These forms are often used in reporting. Compare:

Có nhiều cách nói về hoạt động hay sự kiện ở tương lai tại một thời điểm trong quá khứ. Để diễn đạt ý này, ta dùng dạng quá khứ của những cấu trúc thường dùng để nói về tương lai. Các dạng này thường dùng khi tường thuật. So sánh:

The future from now …
Tương lai tính từ bây giờ …		The future from the past …
Tương lai nhìn từ quá khứ …
I haven’t got much money, so I think I’ll stay at home this summer.
Tôi không có nhiều tiền, nên tôi nghĩ hè này tôi sẽ ở nhà.		Eleni decided that she would stay at home for the summer.
Eleni quyết định hè ấy cô sẽ ở nhà.
I’m not going to say anything about the exams today, because I don’t have time.
Hôm nay tôi sẽ không nói gì về kỳ thi vì không có thời gian.		I wasn’t going to say anything about the exams, but the students asked me to.
Tôi đã không định nói gì về kỳ thi, nhưng học sinh yêu cầu.
I’m having a meeting with my tutor tomorrow to discuss my work.
Ngày mai tôi có buổi gặp giáo viên hướng dẫn để bàn về bài làm.		I couldn’t go to the match because I was having a meeting with my tutor.
Tôi không đi xem trận đấu được vì có buổi gặp giáo viên hướng dẫn.
Will you be going alone, or is Louise going with you?
Bạn sẽ đi một mình hay Louise đi cùng?		At the time, I thought I would be going alone, but then Jan said he wanted to come.
Lúc đó tôi nghĩ mình sẽ đi một mình, nhưng rồi Jan nói muốn đi cùng.
The exam will have finished by three o’clock, so I’ll see you then.
Kỳ thi sẽ kết thúc trước ba giờ, nên lúc đó gặp bạn nhé.		The exam was so easy that most people would have finished after 30 minutes.
Đề thi dễ đến mức hầu hết mọi người đã làm xong sau 30 phút.
There is to be a meeting of ministers this evening.
Tối nay sẽ có cuộc họp các bộ trưởng.		It was announced that there was to be a meeting of ministers that evening.
Có thông báo rằng tối hôm đó sẽ có cuộc họp các bộ trưởng.
When the school closes, all the children are to be moved to one nearby.
Khi trường đóng cửa, tất cả học sinh sẽ được chuyển sang trường gần đó.		Mrs Novak heard that she was to be moved to a post in a nearby school.
Bà Novak nghe tin mình sẽ được chuyển sang một vị trí ở trường gần đó.
As the bell is about to go for the end of the lesson, pack your books away.
Vì chuông sắp reo hết giờ, hãy cất sách vở đi.		The bell was about to go when all the children started to pack their books away.
Chuông sắp reo thì tất cả học sinh bắt đầu cất sách vở.

If the future seen from the past is still in the future for the speaker, then either form is possible:

Nếu tương lai nhìn từ quá khứ vẫn còn là tương lai đối với người nói thì dùng dạng nào cũng được:

  • It was announced this morning that there is / was to be a statement this evening.

    Sáng nay có thông báo rằng tối nay sẽ có một tuyên bố.

In some cases we don’t know whether the activity or event happened or not. Compare:

Trong một số trường hợp ta không biết sự việc có xảy ra hay không. So sánh:

  • I didn’t phone to give him the news because we were seeing each other later. He was very upset when I told him. (= we saw each other)

    Tôi không gọi báo tin cho anh ấy vì chúng tôi sẽ gặp nhau sau đó. Anh ấy rất buồn khi tôi kể. (= chúng tôi đã gặp nhau)

  • We were seeing each other later that day, but I had to phone and cancel. (= we didn’t see each other)

    Chúng tôi định gặp nhau cuối ngày hôm đó, nhưng tôi phải gọi điện hủy. (= chúng tôi không gặp nhau)

B. was / were to + infinitive; was / were to have + past participle

B. was / were to + V; was / were to have + V3

To talk about an activity or event that was in the future at a particular point in the past, we can use was / were to + infinitive (for things that actually happened) and was / were to have + past participle (for things that were expected, but didn’t happen):

Để nói về hoạt động hay sự kiện ở tương lai tại một thời điểm quá khứ, có thể dùng was / were to + V (cho điều thực sự đã xảy ra) và was / were to have + V3 (cho điều được dự kiến nhưng không xảy ra):

  • At the time she was probably the best actor in the theatre company, but in fact some of her colleagues were to become much better known.

    Lúc đó có lẽ cô ấy là diễn viên giỏi nhất đoàn kịch, nhưng thực tế một số đồng nghiệp của cô sau này nổi tiếng hơn nhiều.

  • The boat, which was to have taken them to the island, failed to arrive.

    Con thuyền lẽ ra đưa họ ra đảo đã không đến.

  • He was to find out years later that the car he had bought was stolen.

    Nhiều năm sau anh ấy mới phát hiện ra chiếc xe mình mua là xe ăn cắp.

Note, however, that in less formal contexts it is more natural to use be supposed to:

Tuy nhiên, trong ngữ cảnh ít trang trọng, dùng be supposed to tự nhiên hơn:

  • I was supposed to help, but I was ill. (more natural than I was to have helped …)

    Lẽ ra tôi phải giúp, nhưng tôi bị ốm.

mcq.question: Eleni decided that she ___ at home for the summer.
mcq.full: Eleni decided that she would stay at home for the summer.
mcq.vi: Eleni quyết định hè ấy cô sẽ ở nhà.
mcq.expl:
Future seen from the past: would, was going to, was / were -ing, would be -ing, would have + past participle, was to be, was about to.
Tương lai nhìn từ quá khứ: would, was going to, was / were V-ing, would be V-ing, would have + V3, was to be, was about to.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Tương lai nhìn từ quá khứ → would.
mcq.key: Eleni decided that she ___ at home for the summer.|would stay

mcq.question: I ___ anything about the exams, but the students asked me to.
mcq.full: I wasn’t going to say anything about the exams, but the students asked me to.
mcq.vi: Tôi đã không định nói gì về kỳ thi, nhưng học sinh yêu cầu.
mcq.expl:
Future seen from the past: would, was going to, was / were -ing, would be -ing, would have + past participle, was to be, was about to.
Tương lai nhìn từ quá khứ: would, was going to, was / were V-ing, would be V-ing, would have + V3, was to be, was about to.
Điểm ngữ pháp: was going to → dự định trong quá khứ.
mcq.key: I ___ anything about the exams, but the students asked me to.|wasn’t going to say

mcq.question: I couldn’t go to the match because I ___ a meeting with my tutor.
mcq.full: I couldn’t go to the match because I was having a meeting with my tutor.
mcq.vi: Tôi không đi xem trận đấu được vì có buổi gặp giáo viên hướng dẫn.
mcq.expl:
Future seen from the past: would, was going to, was / were -ing, would be -ing, would have + past participle, was to be, was about to.
Tương lai nhìn từ quá khứ: would, was going to, was / were V-ing, would be V-ing, would have + V3, was to be, was about to.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Sắp xếp nhìn từ quá khứ → was V-ing.
mcq.key: I couldn’t go to the match because I ___ a meeting with my tutor.|was having

mcq.question: At the time, I thought I ___ alone, but then Jan said he wanted to come.
mcq.full: At the time, I thought I would be going alone, but then Jan said he wanted to come.
mcq.vi: Lúc đó tôi nghĩ mình sẽ đi một mình, nhưng rồi Jan nói muốn đi cùng.
mcq.expl:
Future seen from the past: would, was going to, was / were -ing, would be -ing, would have + past participle, was to be, was about to.
Tương lai nhìn từ quá khứ: would, was going to, was / were V-ing, would be V-ing, would have + V3, was to be, was about to.
Điểm ngữ pháp: would be V-ing.
mcq.key: At the time, I thought I ___ alone, but then Jan said he wanted to come.|would be going

mcq.question: The exam was so easy that most people ___ after 30 minutes.
mcq.full: The exam was so easy that most people would have finished after 30 minutes.
mcq.vi: Đề thi dễ đến mức hầu hết mọi người đã làm xong sau 30 phút.
mcq.expl:
Future seen from the past: would, was going to, was / were -ing, would be -ing, would have + past participle, was to be, was about to.
Tương lai nhìn từ quá khứ: would, was going to, was / were V-ing, would be V-ing, would have + V3, was to be, was about to.
Điểm ngữ pháp: would have + V3.
mcq.key: The exam was so easy that most people ___ after 30 minutes.|would have finished

mcq.question: It was announced that there ___ a meeting of ministers that evening.
mcq.full: It was announced that there was to be a meeting of ministers that evening.
mcq.vi: Có thông báo rằng tối hôm đó sẽ có cuộc họp các bộ trưởng.
mcq.expl:
Future seen from the past: would, was going to, was / were -ing, would be -ing, would have + past participle, was to be, was about to.
Tương lai nhìn từ quá khứ: would, was going to, was / were V-ing, would be V-ing, would have + V3, was to be, was about to.
Điểm ngữ pháp: was to be.
mcq.key: It was announced that there ___ a meeting of ministers that evening.|was to be

mcq.question: Mrs Novak heard that she ___ to a post in a nearby school.
mcq.full: Mrs Novak heard that she was to be moved to a post in a nearby school.
mcq.vi: Bà Novak nghe tin mình sẽ được chuyển sang một vị trí ở trường gần đó.
mcq.expl:
Future seen from the past: would, was going to, was / were -ing, would be -ing, would have + past participle, was to be, was about to.
Tương lai nhìn từ quá khứ: would, was going to, was / were V-ing, would be V-ing, would have + V3, was to be, was about to.
Điểm ngữ pháp: was to be + V3.
mcq.key: Mrs Novak heard that she ___ to a post in a nearby school.|was to be moved

mcq.question: The bell ___ go when all the children started to pack their books away.
mcq.full: The bell was about to go when all the children started to pack their books away.
mcq.vi: Chuông sắp reo thì tất cả học sinh bắt đầu cất sách vở.
mcq.expl:
Future seen from the past: would, was going to, was / were -ing, would be -ing, would have + past participle, was to be, was about to.
Tương lai nhìn từ quá khứ: would, was going to, was / were V-ing, would be V-ing, would have + V3, was to be, was about to.
Điểm ngữ pháp: was about to.
mcq.key: The bell ___ go when all the children started to pack their books away.|was about to

mcq.question: I ___ do the washing, but we’d run out of washing powder.
mcq.full: I was going to do the washing, but we’d run out of washing powder.
mcq.vi: Tôi đã định giặt đồ, nhưng hết bột giặt rồi.
mcq.expl:
Future seen from the past: would, was going to, was / were -ing, would be -ing, would have + past participle, was to be, was about to.
Tương lai nhìn từ quá khứ: would, was going to, was / were V-ing, would be V-ing, would have + V3, was to be, was about to.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Dự định không thực hiện → was going to.
mcq.key: I ___ do the washing, but we’d run out of washing powder.|was going to

mcq.question: When we were passing Ivan’s house, we thought we ___ drop in and see him.
mcq.full: When we were passing Ivan’s house, we thought we’d drop in and see him.
mcq.vi: Khi đi ngang nhà Ivan, chúng tôi nghĩ sẽ ghé thăm anh ấy.
mcq.expl:
Future seen from the past: would, was going to, was / were -ing, would be -ing, would have + past participle, was to be, was about to.
Tương lai nhìn từ quá khứ: would, was going to, was / were V-ing, would be V-ing, would have + V3, was to be, was about to.
Điểm ngữ pháp: would nhìn từ quá khứ.
mcq.key: When we were passing Ivan’s house, we thought we ___ drop in and see him.|’d

mcq.question: Where shall I hang my coat? – Sorry, I thought Ella ___ shown you. Over there.
mcq.full: Where shall I hang my coat? – Sorry, I thought Ella would have shown you. Over there.
mcq.vi: Tôi treo áo khoác ở đâu? – Xin lỗi, tôi tưởng Ella đã chỉ cho bạn rồi. Đằng kia.
mcq.expl:
Future seen from the past: would, was going to, was / were -ing, would be -ing, would have + past participle, was to be, was about to.
Tương lai nhìn từ quá khứ: would, was going to, was / were V-ing, would be V-ing, would have + V3, was to be, was about to.
Điểm ngữ pháp: thought + would have + V3.
mcq.key: Where shall I hang my coat? – Sorry, I thought Ella ___ shown you. Over there.|would have

mcq.question: I knew that by the morning I ___ exhausted, but I just wanted to go dancing.
mcq.full: I knew that by the morning I would be feeling exhausted, but I just wanted to go dancing.
mcq.vi: Tôi biết đến sáng tôi sẽ thấy kiệt sức, nhưng tôi chỉ muốn đi nhảy.
mcq.expl:
Future seen from the past: would, was going to, was / were -ing, would be -ing, would have + past participle, was to be, was about to.
Tương lai nhìn từ quá khứ: would, was going to, was / were V-ing, would be V-ing, would have + V3, was to be, was about to.
Điểm ngữ pháp: would be V-ing.
mcq.key: I knew that by the morning I ___ exhausted, but I just wanted to go dancing.|would be feeling

mcq.question: We didn’t expect that having a rabbit as a pet ___ so many problems.
mcq.full: We didn’t expect that having a rabbit as a pet would cause so many problems.
mcq.vi: Chúng tôi không ngờ nuôi thỏ lại gây ra nhiều rắc rối đến thế.
mcq.expl:
Future seen from the past: would, was going to, was / were -ing, would be -ing, would have + past participle, was to be, was about to.
Tương lai nhìn từ quá khứ: would, was going to, was / were V-ing, would be V-ing, would have + V3, was to be, was about to.
Điểm ngữ pháp: expected (quá khứ) → would.
mcq.key: We didn’t expect that having a rabbit as a pet ___ so many problems.|would cause

mcq.question: The concert tonight ___ over by about 9:30. We could eat after that.
mcq.full: The concert tonight will be over by about 9:30. We could eat after that.
mcq.vi: Buổi hòa nhạc tối nay sẽ kết thúc khoảng 9 giờ 30. Sau đó mình đi ăn.
mcq.expl:
If the event is still in the future for the speaker, present or past forms are both possible; if not, use the past form.
Nếu sự việc vẫn còn ở tương lai với người nói thì dùng dạng hiện tại hay quá khứ đều được; nếu không thì dùng dạng quá khứ.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Tương lai tính từ bây giờ → will.
mcq.key: The concert tonight ___ over by about 9:30. We could eat after that.|will be

mcq.question: The second half ___ start, so shall we go back to our seats now?
mcq.full: The second half is about to start, so shall we go back to our seats now?
mcq.vi: Hiệp hai sắp bắt đầu, mình về chỗ ngồi đi?
mcq.expl:
If the event is still in the future for the speaker, present or past forms are both possible; if not, use the past form.
Nếu sự việc vẫn còn ở tương lai với người nói thì dùng dạng hiện tại hay quá khứ đều được; nếu không thì dùng dạng quá khứ.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Sắp xảy ra từ bây giờ → is about to.
mcq.key: The second half ___ start, so shall we go back to our seats now?|is about to

mcq.question: Where’s Oliver? He ___ to be here yesterday, and there’s still no sign of him.
mcq.full: Where’s Oliver? He was supposed to be here yesterday, and there’s still no sign of him.
mcq.vi: Oliver đâu? Lẽ ra anh ấy phải ở đây từ hôm qua mà vẫn chưa thấy đâu.
mcq.expl:
If the event is still in the future for the speaker, present or past forms are both possible; if not, use the past form.
Nếu sự việc vẫn còn ở tương lai với người nói thì dùng dạng hiện tại hay quá khứ đều được; nếu không thì dùng dạng quá khứ.
Điểm ngữ pháp: yesterday → was supposed to.
mcq.key: Where’s Oliver? He ___ to be here yesterday, and there’s still no sign of him.|was supposed

mcq.question: Where’s Oliver? – I ___ ask the same question.
mcq.full: Where’s Oliver? – I was about to ask the same question.
mcq.vi: Oliver đâu? – Tôi cũng vừa định hỏi câu đó.
mcq.expl:
If the event is still in the future for the speaker, present or past forms are both possible; if not, use the past form.
Nếu sự việc vẫn còn ở tương lai với người nói thì dùng dạng hiện tại hay quá khứ đều được; nếu không thì dùng dạng quá khứ.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Nhìn từ quá khứ → was about to.
mcq.key: Where’s Oliver? – I ___ ask the same question.|was about to

mcq.question: DNA testing ___ by police in the search for the missing Dublin schoolboy. His parents have welcomed the news.
mcq.full: DNA testing is to be used by police in the search for the missing Dublin schoolboy. His parents have welcomed the news.
mcq.vi: Cảnh sát sẽ sử dụng xét nghiệm ADN để tìm cậu học sinh mất tích ở Dublin. Bố mẹ cậu hoan nghênh tin này.
mcq.expl:
If the event is still in the future for the speaker, present or past forms are both possible; if not, use the past form.
Nếu sự việc vẫn còn ở tương lai với người nói thì dùng dạng hiện tại hay quá khứ đều được; nếu không thì dùng dạng quá khứ.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Tin mới, vẫn là tương lai → is to be used.
mcq.key: DNA testing ___ by police in the search for the missing Dublin schoolboy. His parents have welcomed the news.|is to be used

mcq.question: We ___ at seven in the Globe coffee bar. Can you be there, too?
mcq.full: We are meeting at seven in the Globe coffee bar. Can you be there, too?
mcq.vi: Chúng tôi sẽ gặp nhau lúc bảy giờ ở quán cà phê Globe. Bạn đến được không?
mcq.expl:
If the event is still in the future for the speaker, present or past forms are both possible; if not, use the past form.
Nếu sự việc vẫn còn ở tương lai với người nói thì dùng dạng hiện tại hay quá khứ đều được; nếu không thì dùng dạng quá khứ.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Kế hoạch tương lai → are meeting (hoặc were meeting).
mcq.key: We ___ at seven in the Globe coffee bar. Can you be there, too?|are meeting

mcq.question: The manager of Newtown United said that the team ___ announced at nine tomorrow.
mcq.full: The manager of Newtown United said that the team is to be announced at nine tomorrow.
mcq.vi: Huấn luyện viên Newtown United nói danh sách đội sẽ được công bố lúc chín giờ sáng mai.
mcq.expl:
If the event is still in the future for the speaker, present or past forms are both possible; if not, use the past form.
Nếu sự việc vẫn còn ở tương lai với người nói thì dùng dạng hiện tại hay quá khứ đều được; nếu không thì dùng dạng quá khứ.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Vẫn là tương lai → is to be (hoặc was to be).
mcq.key: The manager of Newtown United said that the team ___ announced at nine tomorrow.|is to be

mcq.question: I didn’t phone Ben this morning because I was going to see him when I ___ work.
mcq.full: I didn’t phone Ben this morning because I was going to see him when I’ve finished work.
mcq.vi: Sáng nay tôi không gọi cho Ben vì định gặp anh ấy khi làm xong việc.
mcq.expl:
If the event is still in the future for the speaker, present or past forms are both possible; if not, use the past form.
Nếu sự việc vẫn còn ở tương lai với người nói thì dùng dạng hiện tại hay quá khứ đều được; nếu không thì dùng dạng quá khứ.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Mệnh đề thời gian chỉ tương lai → hiện tại hoàn thành.
mcq.key: I didn’t phone Ben this morning because I was going to see him when I ___ work.|’ve finished

mcq.question: I didn’t phone to give him the news because we ___ each other later. He was very upset when I told him.
mcq.full: I didn’t phone to give him the news because we were seeing each other later. He was very upset when I told him.
mcq.vi: Tôi không gọi báo tin vì chúng tôi sẽ gặp nhau sau đó. Anh ấy rất buồn khi tôi kể.
mcq.expl:
If the event is still in the future for the speaker, present or past forms are both possible; if not, use the past form.
Nếu sự việc vẫn còn ở tương lai với người nói thì dùng dạng hiện tại hay quá khứ đều được; nếu không thì dùng dạng quá khứ.
